necessary_context.content: X is a closed convex subset of R^n with nonempty interior. f:X→R is convex and L_f-Lipschitz with respect to a fixed norm. X*=argmin_X f is nonempty. A subgradient f'(x) is computable.

necessary_context.name: Assumption A

necessary_context.content: ψ:X→R is strongly convex and continuously differentiable on int X; Bψ(u,v)=ψ(u)−ψ(v)−<u−v,∇ψ(v)> on X×int X. SANP begins at x1∈int X. The selected records explicitly require attained exact updates remaining in int X. The source also discusses boundary gradient extension and essential smoothness; these alternatives are not silently combined with this selected regime.
